english.title: Appointee fail to give written statement of weight / measurement found on equipment provided for public use
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who had been appointed to attend to

(A)_[weighing]_
(B)_[measuring]_

(C)_[an article,]_
(D)_[a vehicle,]_
(E)_[an animal,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE, VEHICLE OR ANIMAL..) brought for

(F)_[weighing]_
(G)_[measuring]_

by means of equipment provided for that purpose and available for use by the public, failed to deliver a written statement of the

(H)_[weight]_
(I)_[measurement]_

found to the person demanding the

(J)_[weighing]_
(K)_[measuring]_

or an agent of that person
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 20(2)(c) and 84(1) and (2) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person who had been appointed to attend to weighing / measuring
an article / a vehicle / an animal brought for weighing / measuring
by means of equipment provided for that purpose
and available for use by the public
failed to deliver a written statement of the weight / measurement found

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 83 of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that in England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.
